description.value: Lakeview Market is a family-owned neighbourhood grocery store that has anchored the corner of KLO and Pandosy in Kelowna's Mission district since 1946, surviving a fire in 2003 and remaining in the Jones family to this day. It emphasises locally sourced products across all departments and operates a scratch bakery producing fresh breads, sandwiches, quiches, and pasties in-house daily. Long-tenured staff and a strong community reputation make it a welcoming provisioning stop for touring cyclists passing through the Mission district.
